triples.evidence_text: The pump is to be self-priming.

triples.tail_surface: heating arrangements are to be provided
triples.evidence_text: If this is impracticable, or if lower temperatures are likely to be encountered, heating arrangements are to be providedso that ready starting will be assured.

triples.tail_surface: equipped with an approved auxiliary starting device
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 配备认可的辅助启动装置
triples.evidence_text: Diesel engines exceeding 15 kW are to be equipped with an approved auxiliary starting device, e.g. starting battery, independent hydraulic starting system or independent starting air system.

triples.tail_surface: minimum available net positive suction head is to provide a safety margin of at least the 1 meter (3.3 feet) or 30% of required net positive suction head of the pump
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 最小可用净正吸入压头需提供至少1米或泵所需净正吸入压头30%的安全裕量
triples.evidence_text: In selecting the emergency fire pump, the minimum available net positive suction head is to provide a safety margin of at least the 1 meter (3.3 feet) or 30% of required net positive suction head of the pump, whichever is less.

triples.head_surface: Short lengths of suction or discharge piping
triples.tail_surface: enclosed in a substantial steel casing
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 封装在坚固钢质套管内
triples.evidence_text: Short lengths of suction or discharge piping may penetrate the machinery space containing the main fire pump or pumps, provided they are enclosed in a substantial steel casing, or are insulated to A-60 class standard.
